speaker: alse_pinder
text: I have the basin. I am not coming up behind you, sir. The second turning is enough of the stair for one day, and I have already climbed it once with a jug.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Let him go. The kitchen is the kitchen until six. I am not sending a plot up after him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am gone. Leave the sheet if you come as far as the door. It is dry, and it is staying.
